SELECT p.tenant_id,p.task_id FROM task_session_history p JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND t.id=p.task_id WHERE p.history_version=5p.history_version<>5 AND p.content_state='PRESENT' AND p.retain_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND t.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a WHERE a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.task_id=p.task_id AND a.quiescent=FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invocation i WHERE i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.task_id=p.task_id AND i.state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN','UNKNOWN')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invocation_session_lineage_trace x WHERE x.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND x.caller_task_id=p.task_id AND x.outcome IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invocation_session_scope_query x WHERE x.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND x.caller_task_id=p.task_id AND x.outcome IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.task_id=p.task_id AND (r.state='HELD_UNKNOWN' OR r.usage_quality='UNKNOWN' OR (r.state='RESERVED' AND r.category<>'SESSION_HISTORY_STORAGE'))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.task_id=p.task_id AND d.state IN ('DISPATCHED','USAGE_UNKNOWN','BOUND_EXCEEDED')) ORDER BY p.retain_until,p.tenant_id,p.task_id LIMIT 16

SELECT id FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN','UNKNOWN') UNION ALL SELECT invocation_id AS id FROM invocation_session_lineage_trace WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{taskId} AND outcome IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN') UNION ALL SELECT invocation_id AS id FROM invocation_session_scope_query WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND caller_task_id=#{taskId} AND outcome IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN','OUTCOME_UNKNOWN') LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND (state='HELD_UNKNOWN' OR usage_quality='UNKNOWN' OR (state='RESERVED' AND category<>'SESSION_HISTORY_STORAGE')) LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state IN ('DISPATCHED','USAGE_UNKNOWN','BOUND_EXCEEDED') LIMIT 1
